<bbm-response>
<bbm-unit id="pc4baec48c1a6_0">"N—No?" ${一色} was dumbfounded, that made so much sense?!</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pc4baec48c1a6_1">"There never was any ironclad rule stating that whatever gender a body is, the soul and consciousness must strictly correspond to it. Look, didn't Meiguo just come up with 108 genders recently?"</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pc4baec48c1a6_2">"That's them, they're sick." ${一色} sobbed, not forgetting to curse.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pc4baec48c1a6_3">"Geez! I'm speaking up for you! Well then, why don't you tell me yourself whether you actually want to be a boy or a girl, ${一色}!"</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pc4baec48c1a6_4">"Uhm... This question might not have been a problem for me before, but now... I don't even know what I want to become anymore.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pc4baec48c1a6_5">"At least now, my perception of myself is starting to blur. Is this the price of gaining extraordinary power?</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pc4baec48c1a6_6">"Having formidable strength yet failing to forge the heart of a powerhouse is probably why my mind is wandering like this.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pc4baec48c1a6_7">"Actually, back in elementary school, I really wanted to be a girl, because girls are so cute and I wanted to transform too. But back then, I was a bona fide boy; I couldn't be soft and delicate like girls, I couldn't act spoiled, I couldn't shed tears easily, I had to abide by the law, be strong, become a real man, and protect the people I love..."</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pc4baec48c1a6_8">${美琴} smiled gently, like brilliant stars shining in ${一色}'s eyes.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pc4baec48c1a6_9">"Dwelling within ${一色}'s body is an untamed, pure soul."</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pc4baec48c1a6_10">Ah, what on earth I am doesn't even feel important anymore.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pc4baec48c1a6_11">I just want to safeguard this priceless treasure. </bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pc4baec48c1a6_12">${一色} was still streaming with tears, but was no longer choking up.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pc4baec48c1a6_13">Are these tears of happiness, or tears of rebirth?</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pc4baec48c1a6_14">Perhaps they are both.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pc4baec48c1a6_15">The shackles binding the soul were torn apart, and the flame of the soul broke free from its formless restraints, giving birth to a harmonious new shape.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pc4baec48c1a6_16">Gazing at ${美琴}, ${一色} saw the young girl's eyes as bright and charming as autumn water.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pc4baec48c1a6_17">She lunged fiercely toward her older sister, tightly embracing the young girl's body.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pc4baec48c1a6_18">"Ara ara, what a spoiled child~ There, there~" ${美琴} gently stroked ${一色}'s head, whispering softly in her ear.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pc4baec48c1a6_19">No matter how strong she becomes, in the end, she is still that same ${一色}.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pc4baec48c1a6_20">She is that little cutie who has loved following right behind her since childhood, always acting spoiled in front of her sister, and obeying her sister's every word in everything.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pc4baec48c1a6_21">My younger sister, ${御坂一色}.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pc4baec48c1a6_22">My family, ${一色}.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pc4baec48c1a6_23">"I still want to be with my sister, want to live together with my sister, want to live together with everyone at ${常盘台}, I'm so scared of losing everything here..."</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pc4baec48c1a6_24">"Of course you can, ${一色}. Or rather, it's your sister who is even more reluctant to part with ${一色}. If you dare to run away on your own, I'll chase you to the ends of the earth."</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pc4baec48c1a6_25">"Wuwuwu! Sister~ dasuki—wuwuwu..."</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pc4baec48c1a6_26">Ultimately, ${一色} burst into heavy tears once more.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pc4baec48c1a6_27">The worries long hidden deep within her heart and the fear of losing her haven all melted away like smoke amidst her weeping.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pc4baec48c1a6_28">It's a rebirth, ${一色}.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pc4baec48c1a6_29">Yet looking at it this way, this demeanor of yours makes you a mortal after all.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pc4baec48c1a6_30">Still, what's wrong with that?</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pc4baec48c1a6_31">No one was ever forcing you or demanding that you become a god.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pc4baec48c1a6_32">Confessing to her was a questioning of your own heart, and also a trial.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pc4baec48c1a6_33">You delivered a perfect answer sheet.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pc4baec48c1a6_34">Open your heart to the person you love and the person who loves you.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pc4baec48c1a6_35">You have achieved a happy conclusion, what a wonderful thing.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pc4baec48c1a6_36">Continue to be a happy person from now on, ${一色}.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pc4baec48c1a6_37">You all too.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pc4baec48c1a6_38">P.S. I wrote this and cried back then, but looking at it now, it feels a bit baffling instead.</bbm-unit>
<bbm-unit id="pc4baec48c1a6_39">I wonder what everyone's impression is, and whether you'll find it nonsensical.</bbm-unit>
</bbm-response>
